note: Both sets capture the ~100 issues/concerns across four mission concepts from the initial LCIT reviews, though each states that same fact twice. Set B adds a third claim binding '100' to 'mission concepts' as a quantity, which is a misbinding: the page says there are four mission concepts and ~100 issues/concerns. Set A therefore has no wrong claims while B has one, making A the better set despite its duplication.
remarks: Both sets extract only the first bullet's numeric fact and ignore the rest of the page (STDT modifications before public release, per-finding feedback and change references, and the significant reduction of remaining issues after LCIT re-review). The page is largely narrative with only one quantitative fact, so the extraction sets are thin; the '100' figure is explicitly approximate ('approximately 100'), which neither set records in the value field.
